name: Haelan ClimateCore Long-Sleeve Shirt
description:
A long-sleeve button-down that regulates its own thermal output through a distributed micro-filament network woven into the fabric. The shirt reads ambient temperature and the wearer's skin temperature simultaneously, adjusting the filament activation to maintain a preset comfort band. The result is that you can wear this in a cold transit tunnel and a heated office and feel roughly the same in both. The fabric looks and feels like a standard fine-weave synth-linen — matte, professional, available in eight colors including a sharp teal called 'Caspian' and a warm grey called 'Mineral.'

Haelan markets this as their 'executive productivity' line — the idea being that you think better when you're not adjusting your thermostat every twenty minutes. The shirt pairs a legitimate tech feature with clean, conservative styling that reads as professional in any Tier 3 or 4 setting. The collar stays crisp. The cuffs have a single button.
functionality: Distributed micro-filament network provides active thermal regulation across a 12-degree comfort band. Battery-free — powered by body heat differential. No BCI required; operates passively.
what_it_says: You've invested in quality where quality makes sense. You're practical about tech — you use it when it works, not to impress anyone.
worn_by: people who commute through multiple climate zones daily
story_hooks: A batch of ClimateCore shirts distributed through a third-party retailer was discovered to have an additional sensor layer that reports location and biometric data — Haelan claims it was a manufacturing error.
The micro-filament network can be adapted, with the right tools, into a rudimentary signal-interference layer — someone on the Shelf figured this out and is selling the modification.
A character running in from the cold walks into a meeting wearing this and the shirt is still adjusting — the slight shimmer of the fabric activating catches the wrong person's attention.

physical_description.visual_profile: A refined, minimalist button-down with a clean executive silhouette. The matte finish and structured collar project quiet competence rather than ostentation. Worn by mid-tier professionals navigating climate-controlled corporate spaces and unregulated street-level infrastructure.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not restrictive—designed to accommodate layering or worn solo. Sits close to the shoulder, tapers at the waist, with a straight drop through the torso. Sleeves taper toward fitted single-button cuffs.
physical_description.primary_material: Fine-weave synth-linen composite with integrated micro-filament thermal regulation network. Feels smooth, breathable, and almost organic despite its technical augmentation.
physical_description.texture: Matte surface with subtle micro-texture from the woven filament grid beneath. No visible circuitry or panel lines—the tech is completely seamless and invisible to casual observation.
physical_description.color_scheme: Eight colorways including 'Caspian' (sophisticated teal-blue) and 'Mineral' (warm neutral grey). Other options likely span professional palette: charcoal, ivory, steel, sage, ochre, and deep navy.
physical_description.closures: Standard mother-of-pearl or composite buttons down the front. Single button at each cuff. No visible power interface or adjustment controls—thermal settings managed via subcutaneous haptic link or companion app.
distinctive_features: Invisible micro-filament thermal regulation network woven throughout fabric
Crisp, professional collar that maintains structure through wear
Single cuff button—minimal, functional detail work
No visible tech branding or indicator lights—luxury through invisibility
Minimal seaming to preserve thermal fabric integrity
Subtle Haelan Group woven tag at interior neckline
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 luxury. Priced for working professionals and minor corporate employees. A statement of stable employment and access to augmented comfort tech without the flashiness of visible chrome.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals mid-tier corporate worker, logistics manager, middle-management exec, or stable service sector professional. Worn by people who move between climate-controlled office towers and unregulated transit infrastructure. The opposite of street-wear or salvage aesthetics.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. Haelan targets professionals who treat their wardrobes carefully. After years of wear, might show gentle fading or soft creasing at collar, but rarely torn or patched.

image_prompt: A Tier 3 corporate professional wearing a Haelan ClimateCore shirt in Caspian teal, photographed in a moody split-lighting setup. One side lit by cool fluorescent office glow, the other by warm amber from a street-level neon sign bleeding through a transit tunnel window. The model is poised, relaxed but alert, perhaps adjusting a cuff or checking an implanted display on their wrist. Dark mannequin alternative: shirt buttoned halfway, draped on sleek form against a backdrop of thermal-imaging feed on screens. Fabric detail shot showing the matte micro-texture catching light. Cyberpunk aesthetic: professional, augmented, effortlessly blended between corpo and street. --ar 2:3 --v 6
